pandaos.source: Derived per server by report.load_prices(--server KEY): monthly = usd_per_month + setup_usd/12 + backup_usd_per_month; host $/h = monthly/730; per-VM $/h = host $/h / vms_overcommit_1_0 (conservative / untrusted count; 100% utilization, no operator time). density_model: trusted = vms_overcommit_1_5 on vcpu_threads, untrusted = vms_untrusted on cores.

assumptions.usd_per_eur_source: approx. spot, Oct 2026 (https://30rates.com/eur-usd-forecast-tomorrow-this-week); unverified for today
assumptions.admission: bench/boatbench/admission.py, constants read from components/boat/boatd/config.go defaultConfig(): floor((MemTotal - hostReserveMiB) x memOvercommit / (8192 + vmOverheadMiB)) default VMs (manager.go quotaLocked), capped by floor(threads x cpuOvercommit / 4). MemTotal is ESTIMATED as RAM sold x 63/64 (struct page) - 256 MiB firmware (unverified); vms_as_sold_* use RAM as sold, an upper bound. vms_untrusted: memOvercommit 1 and SMT off (threads = cores).
assumptions.extra_ipv4: none; boat.dev-style access uses IPv6 + gateway URLs. Primary IPv4 is in the Hetzner list price (EUR 1.70/mo per extra IPv4, EUR 4.90 setup); OVH US $2.00/mo per extra IP

retention.nominal_source: 51 GiB disk + 8 GiB memory snapshot (+ logs) per default VM, charged running or stopped under storageOvercommit 1 (components/boat/boatd/snapshot.go hostStorageCheck); untrustedTenants forces storageOvercommit 1
thin_gib_per_vm: measured: a stopped default VM after the Node loop setup, btrfs exclusive bytes incl. memory snapshot, 3.35 GiB; PandaOS AX42 2026-11-12, results/ax42-pandaos-2026-11-12/thin.json
retention.thin_measured_note: A fresh stopped default VM held 0.47 GiB exclusive; the 2.76 GiB guest image is shared by reflinks and counted once per host, not per VM. Thin provisioning is a MODEL: boatd ships no such setting for untrusted mode.
